weather.summary: Mostly Sunny then Slight Chance Showers And Thunderstorms
weather.blurb: Triple digits again. Water bottle, shade, and an early start.

air.blurb: Clean air today. The heat is the thing to plan around, not the smog.

lake.blurb: The lake is close to full — good for boats and for the summer water supply. Down a touch from last week.

pollen.note: Tree 2 · Grass 3 · Weed 3 · Grasses, Ragweed, Elm
pollen.blurb: Grasses and ragweed and elm are up. Allergy folks, take the pill before it takes you.

grid.blurb: A busy afternoon: demand near 83,900 megawatts, with 103,300 on hand.

sun.blurb: The sun is up for 12 hours and 42 minutes today, and down by 7:51 p.m.
